column3: Appearance sits in the Settings Account group, its search terms are its section and row labels, and General drops its Theme row
column4: After #72, Appearance's theme grid (selectTheme) and General's Theme select (applyTheme) were two controls for one choice; Reduce motion stays in General because Appearance has no such row. Appearance's rows use its own components, so it renders outside the row filter instead of showing a false empty state
column5: e2e: every section and row label on every page, Appearance included, finds its page from the search
